businessGoal: Allow visitors to view full product details before making a purchase decision.

scenarios.goal: Verify that the product detail page is displayed after clicking on a product from the overview or category page.
Verify that the product information (image, name, description, price, category badge, brand badge) is shown on the product detail page.
Verify that related products are displayed below the main product information section and are clickable.

clarifications: What happens if the product has no related products?
Is there a limit to the number of related products displayed?
